# Update Every Frame

Source: [wiki article 4789](../archive/4789.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Update Every Frame](../../api/values/update-every-frame.md).

<a id="wiki-4789-n1"></a>

- Update Every Frame increases update frequency for conditions and reevaluating action parameters; it can smooth positions/effects/cameras and sharpen positional triggers.

<a id="wiki-4789-n2"></a>

- Logical updates and visual updates are distinguished: article gives 12.5Hz baseline Position Of, 62.5Hz logical updates and client-frame-rate visual updates.

<a id="wiki-4789-n3"></a>

- Higher frequency can cost server load and/or client frame rate; source recommends selective use and considers one wrapped condition/action cheaper than tight-loop repetition.
